.. change::
    :tags: feature, operations

    Added support for renaming a table within a
    :meth:`.Operations.batch_alter_table` block, via the new
    :meth:`.BatchOperations.rename_table` method.  The rename is combined
    with any other column or constraint operations in the same batch into a
    single "move and copy" table rebuild, so that SQLite migrations no
    longer need a separate ``op.rename_table()`` step outside of the batch.
    Self-referential foreign keys are pointed at the new table name, and on
    SQLite the original table is first renamed to its final name before
    being dropped, so that foreign keys in other tables are rewritten to
    the new name.  A new ``reapply_naming_convention`` option allows
    constraint and index names that are known to have been generated by a
    naming convention to be regenerated against the new table name.
